data.narrative:
Poolside is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Jason Warner and Eiso Kant, having raised $626M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable set spanning 1 public company (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI, all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $626M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis benchmarks against three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B). The median across these three peers is $3.2B, with a range from $2.0B to $5.6B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B (low) to $3.7B (high), with a median of $2.2B. This wide spread reflects material uncertainty inherent in early-stage frontier-tech valuation. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods—driven by divergent comparables in an immature category—highlights sensitivity to comp selection and the difficulty in establishing normalized multiples for AI infrastructure at this stage. Key uncertainties include product differentiation relative to the peer set and the sustainability of current Series B valuations in this sector.
